uncertain: Ext. Pins: the physical pins sit on the end face and are not visible; positions follow the callout list and the back-label column (GND 5V 25 33 22 21)
PORT.A: the callout list beside the bottom view is matched to the Grove connector by proximity and the back-label column (GND 5V 26 32); the individual contacts are not drawn
notes: Back-label notes RGB:G27, BTN:G39, CLK:G5 DAT:G19 (mic), TXD:G3 RXD:G1 (CH552) and IR LED:G12 are internal assignments, not header pins. USB-A plug skipped.
